answer: Each epoch an agent economy auctions scarce compute-inlet leases: only K unique inbound endpoints can receive paid work that epoch. Winning leases are non-transferable and burn if unused. Clones spiral cost because one operator must clear K+N bids to keep N fakes alive, while honest agents need a single inlet. Unleased identities earn nothing until the next reward horizon, so bulk fakes die on fee burn rather than peer votes.
